## How it was tested

<!--
Which suites you ran, and — if it touches input, networking or the protocol —
what you saw on real hardware. "Tests pass" is necessary, not sufficient, for
anything on the hot path.
-->

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`
- [ ] `flutter test` and `dart analyze`
- [ ] Tried on a real phone and PC, if it affects input or the link

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Comments explain *why*, not what
- [ ] No new warnings
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed, including any claim in the README
